pageTitle: Enchanted Tales of the Mikawa Festival/Akitsu Harpastum: Dreams Doubled
name: Akitsu Harpastum aux rêves doublés
description: The opening battle for the new iteration of "Akitsu Harpastum"! Now, will the sound of the sand-colored bake-danuki hitting a harpastum be more of a "clack," like rock, or a "biff," like a sandy beach?
